description: Several steps in order in one call, e.g. fill a form's fields and submit it; each gets the same checks as its own tool. Stops at the first that fails, or after one that moves the page to another address (later refs would belong to the old page). Returns a line per step and the evidence and visible screen after the last one run.

action.description: click, select, type take ref; type: text (submit: Enter after); select: values; press: key; scroll: direction; wait: seconds

ref.description: From the latest snapshot, e.g. "e12" or "f1e3"

name: browser_actions
title: Several actions in one call
